setShortcut-actor.label: Actor
setShortcut-actor.tip: Set the shortcut for this actor

set-item-shortcut.name: Set Item Shortcut
set-item-shortcut.tip: Bind the item with the specified ID to the shortcut key

set-skill-shortcut.name: Set Skill Shortcut
set-skill-shortcut.tip: Bind the skill with the specified ID to the shortcut key

delete-shortcut.name: Delete Shortcut
delete-shortcut.tip: Unbind the shortcut key from the corresponding item or skill

swap-shortcuts.name: Swap Shortcuts
swap-shortcuts.tip: Swap the contents of the two shortcut key bindings (empty ones are also acceptable)

setShortcut-key.label: Shortcut Key
setShortcut-key.tip: Shortcut key for item or skill

setShortcut-key2.label: Shortcut Key 2
setShortcut-key2.tip: Shortcut key 2 for item or skill

setShortcut-itemId.label: Item
setShortcut-itemId.tip: Bind this item to the shortcut key

setShortcut-skillId.label: Skill
setShortcut-skillId.tip: Bind this skill to the shortcut key
